learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Mechanical Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Capacity for organization and planning in the field of business, and other institutions and organizations.
Honesty, responsibility, ethical commitment, and solidarity.
Ability to work in a team.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework. Organization and management of companies.
Understand the concept of a company, types of companies and the environment in which it operates.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate the company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of company: economic, organizational, and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision-making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
teaching_methods: Case analysis from document reading and video viewing
Presentation of individual or group assignments
assessment_rules: For ordinary evaluation, the final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = EX.ORD + P1 + P2 + P3 + P. A minimum of 40% (2.6 points) is required in the final exam (EX.ORD) and a minimum of 40% (1.4 points) in the sum of P1, P2, P3, and P. The course is approved if all minimums are met and at least 5 points are obtained overall. If all minimums are met but less than 5 points are obtained, the course is failed with the calculated grade. If the final grade exceeds 5 points but a minimum is not met, the final grade will be 4 points (Fail). For extraordinary evaluation, the final grade can be EX.EXTR + EX.PR, EX.ORD + EX.PR (if EX.ORD minimum was met), or EX.EXTR + P1 + P2 + P3 + P (if P1, P2, P3, P minimum was met), with similar minimums and grading rules.
